data.action: 独坐雨夜回廊，一手持墨碟、一手沿湿袍探向腿间，水墨游鱼环绕
data.description: 【成年夕 · 雨夜回廊的水墨独处】成年夕独自坐在雨夜红木回廊的竹席上，湿透黑袍敞开并聚在腰际。她一手端着浅墨碟，另一手沿雨水探入腿间，黑色游鱼随呼吸在地板水光中显形。
data.promptProse: She sits on a bamboo mat against a wooden pillar, her wet robe gathered at her waist, with an ink dish in one hand and the other beneath the robe hem. Dim lantern light breaks across the wet floorboards where painted black koi spread.
data.title: 夕 · 雨夜廊下
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the ink dish; painted black koi spread across the wet floorboards.
